VM - List of Variables.vi

Owning Palette: Advanced VarMan VIs

Returns information about all variables existing in the specified Variable Context.

Click the parameters for more information

 

VC Handle specifies a handle of the variable context. In order to get list of global variables, pass value of -1 to VC Handle or keep it unwired.
sort specifies a variable property is to be used to sort variables info array :

0don't sortDefault value
1name
2alias
3type
reverse? (F). If it is equal to TRUE, VI sorts the output list in reversed order. By default, it is equal to FALSE.
error in describes error conditions that occur before this VI runs. This input provides standard error in functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains error code.
source contains additional error information.
dup VC Handle is a flow-through parameter with the same value as VC Handle.
variables info indicator is an array of clusters that contains information on all variables residing in the given context. An element of the array is a cluster that has the following members:
name of the variable.
alias is an aliad associated with the variable.
type is data type of the variable.
history equals TRUE if variable has a history.
error out contains error information. This output provides standard error out functionality.
status indicates error status.
code contains VarMan VI error code identifying an error if any occurred. If no error occurred, it is equal to zero.
source contains the error description and VI location information if an error occurred.
